newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as LIT, Witter sell early.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as LIT, Witter sell early.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower with LIT America and Dean Witter offering the market early which triggered local selling, traders said.
"Witter and LIT were early sellers and that set the tone plus there was local selling," a trader said.
Term Commodities was bidding for the March and offering the other months but the firm accomplished dealings in only a few lots, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 600 contracts, below the 1,226 traded Friday.
Rice futures closed one to 19 cents per cwt lower, with March down 13 at $12.03 per cwt.
